scope: Isolated component/action/SQL harness, synthetic identity helpers; not Mac/Supabase E2E
checks: Desktop: existing video, lesson context and management controls render
390px: accessible modal, no horizontal overflow; default is internal
Invalid URL rejected by actual Server Action; form stays open and preserves input
Save → SQL → refreshed list → reload preserves title, canonical link and lesson
Parent: internal video absent; no add/edit/remove controls
Edit and share: parent receives updated link and note; mobile stays within viewport
Remove: confirmation, successful SQL soft-delete and disappearance from parent view
No browser JavaScript or console errors
